notes: לְבַדְּךָ → 'thee only': the second לְ was left unrepresented beside בַּד → only. Rule 30 fuses a preposition with its construct noun where one English word carries the pair and forbids marking the preposition unrepresented beside a construct noun holding the whole word; the corpus fuses לְבַדּ- → only/alone in ~50 units. The suffix keeps its own 'thee'.
